description: Learn more about Iowa State Senator Molly Donahue, a lifelong community member and dedicated advocate for Iowa’s families. With over 33 years of experience in public education and a proven record in state government, Molly is committed to empowering every voice across rural and urban communities. Discover her journey from local roots to legislative leadership, grounded in hard work, integrity, and a passion for making a difference. Stay connected with Molly for updates on her work for Iowans.
title: ABOUT MOLLY | Molly Donahue
